# TauHat {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
TauHat()
```
Chart choice for spatial ordinal patterns (SOPs): the statistic $\hat{\tau} = \hat{p}_1 - 1/3$, based on the relative frequency of the first SOP type.
 


:::
